name: Parks and Recreation Commission Youth Member
what_you_do: Be the teen member of a city group that gives advice on parks, beaches and rec centers. You go to about six public meetings a year and share ideas with city leaders.
who_can_apply: Goleta residents ages 15 to 18. One of the four open seats is for a youth member.
duration: The notice lists a 4-year term for this commission. About 6 regular meetings a year, plus more as needed.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the city's boards page. It is due Nov 12, 2026. Send questions to the City Clerk at cityclerkgroup@cityofgoleta.gov.
notes: Only one youth seat, so it is competitive. The city notice was posted Oct 13, 2026. It lists the same 4-year term for the youth seat as for the general seats, so ask the City Clerk how long the youth term lasts. Meetings are public.
